Chapter 123 - 123 Skillful Scanning; Secret!

Chapter 123 - 123 Skillful Scanning; Secret!

123 Skillful Scanning; Secret!

The next day.

A few birds were chirping outside the window, and a ray of warm sunlight gently shone on the window sill. Everything was so quiet and peaceful.

Lin Fan, who was lying on the big bed, slowly opened his eyes. He looked at his phone out of habit.

A text message was already on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 1,430,000 yuan was deposited into your account at 12 AM.]

Lin Fan washed up and walked out of his room.

At that moment, Huang Ling, Huang Yipeng, and Li Min were sitting in the living room and chatting in low voices.

When Lin Fan appeared, the three of them stopped chatting and turned their gazes to him.

Being stared at by the three of them, Lin Fan could not help but feel a little awkward. He coughed lightly and said, “You guys must be hungry. Let’s go have breakfast first.”

Then, they left the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex and went to a nearby restaurant.

The restaurant was elegantly decorated, and the breakfast was delicious with a wide variety.

Of course, the price was a little more expensive. The breakfast for four people cost about 800 yuan in total.

“Uncle, Aunt, why don’t you stay in Jiangbei for a few more days?” Lin Fan said as he wiped his mouth.

Huang Yipeng waved his hand and said, “Our shop hasn’t been open for two days. We can’t keep it closed anymore. Moreover, we just signed a strategic agreement with Xiao Wu Wholesale City, so we need to go back early to prepare.”

Huang Yipeng could not hide the smile on his face.

At the same time, the way he looked at Lin Fan became even fierier.

Li Min, who was sitting next to him, could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, how do you know the chairman and the general manager of Xiao Wu Wholesale City?”

Huang Yipeng and Huang Ling both perked up their ears.

Clearly, they were also very concerned about this issue.

“Oh, because I have 51% of the shares of Xiao Wu Wholesale City,” Lin Fan said casually.

Huang Yipeng’s spoon fell to the ground, and he was completely stunned.

As the manager of the retail store, he knew very well how huge the financial resources of Xiao Wu Wholesale City were.

Lin Fan… He actually owned 51% of Xiao Wu Wholesale City’s shares?

If he had said that the first time he met Lin Fan, Huang Yipeng would have spat on his face.

At this moment, he completely believed it!

This was the only reason why the chairman and the general manager of Xiao Wu Wholesale City were so polite to him and even tried to please him!

On the highway…

Nostalgic music was playing in the Toyota Corolla.

Li Min’s slightly aged face was blushing due to the direct sunlight.

She seemed to have thought of some beautiful images, and a smile appeared on her face. “My Lil Ling has good eyes!

“If only she could get pregnant earlier… I have to let my daughter nourish her body!”

As Li Min spoke, she took out her phone and quickly typed a message.

Suddenly, Huang Yipeng’s phone rang.

He pressed the answer button in the car.

“Is this… Is this Brother Huang?” A hoarse voice came from the car’s stereo.

“It’s me, and you are?” Huang Yipeng said.

“I’m Xiong Jianping. Brother Huang, I was wrong in the past. Please don’t hold it against me…” Manager Xiong said in a sobbing voice.

…

At that moment, Lin Fan arrived at Jiangbei University.

Lin Fan had just sat down in his classroom when Song Jiaxin walked over.

“How did you calculate this?” she asked as she took out her notebook.

Lin Fan looked at the densely packed formulas in the notebook. It was Zhou’s Conjecture!

With Song Jiaxin’s family background, she did not need to study mathematics.

Obviously, as she had said before, she was really interested in mathematics.

Unfortunately, Song Jiaxin’s interest did not make her the best in mathematics.

This was because the equation in front of Lin Fan was only the most basic calculation of Zhou’s conjecture.

However, she could not understand it at all.

Lin Fan picked up his pen and wrote down the most detailed steps in his blank notebook.

Song Jiaxin looked at the floating calculations in the notebook and fell into a daze. No one knew what she was thinking.

At this moment, the bell rang from outside.

The old professor walked in slowly with a textbook in his hand.

It had to be said that the old professor’s teaching method was really hypnotizing.

Even though Lin Fan had already slept through the night, Lin Fan’s eyelids felt heavy and he fell asleep not long after the lesson started.

In the afternoon, when he was eating in the canteen, Lin Fan’s phone vibrated.

12:00 PM!

The red packets were here!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 19,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received Skillful Scanning.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five yuan.]

Today, Lin Fan earned a total of 42,189 yuan.

He naturally did not care about this little bit of money.

Lin Fan immediately focused his attention on Skillful Scanning.

[Skillful Scanning: photographic memory and a skill that can quickly absorb knowledge. Superb memory and reading ability. Not only can you quickly grasp knowledge, but you can also display a special charm!]

When Lin Fan saw this, his eyes lit up immediately.

In the past, he often fantasized about having a photographic memory. He did not expect that it would become a reality today!

This was definitely a very good skill.

After Lin Fan finished his lunch, he went back to his dormitory and impatiently picked up a textbook. He quickly flipped through it.

With just a glance, the first page’s dense content seemed to be engraved into his mind. It was extremely magical.

Lin Fan could not help but be excited as he flipped to the second page, third page, fourth page…

In just two minutes, Lin Fan could actually recite the entire book backward!

Lin Fan read three books in a row before his interest slowly faded.

At this moment, the phone in his pocket vibrated slightly.

It was a message from Teacher Tiantian.

Hu Tian: [If you’re free tonight, come over to my house.]

Yesterday, Huang Ling’s parents had come and Lin Fan had been holding it in for the entire night.

At that moment, when he saw the message, Lin Fan’s heart could not help but beat faster. He quickly replied to the message.

Lin Fan replied: [Since you invited me, I’ll definitely make time.]

When the school bell rang in the afternoon, Lin Fan drove the Pagani Huayra toward Hu Tian’s house.

At this time, it was time to get off work, and the road was very congested.

Even though Hu Tian’s home was not far from Jiangbei, Lin Fan still spent close to an hour.

Lin Fan knocked on the door slowly. Very quickly, the door opened with a creak.

At the next moment, Lin Fan was a little stunned.

That was because the person who opened the door was not Hu Tian but Chu Yunyue.

Just when Lin Fan thought that he had come to the wrong place, Hu Tian appeared in front of him.

At that moment, the two women’s scent, their similar house decorations, and other things all came together in Lin Fan’s mind.

Chu Yunyue was actually the one Hu Tian was talking about. Her girlfriend?

…

Tonight would be another sleepless night!
